name: watch-for-me
description: Watch any video for your agent: YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok or a local file. Speech transcribed on your device, keyframes read by your agent, several videos in parallel.

interface.shortDescription: Watch any video: local transcription + keyframes
interface.longDescription: Give the agent a video link (YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok, Vimeo, Loom and more) or a local file. Speech is transcribed on your device, keyframes are extracted into contact sheets that the agent reads, and the answer comes back as a timestamped timeline of what is said and shown. Summaries, steps, code, quotes or answers to a question. Up to 10 videos in parallel.
defaultPrompt: Use watch-for-me to summarize this video: <link>
Watch this video and give me the steps as a checklist.
Watch these videos and tell me what they say about <topic>.
